description: A FACTUAL, source-cited, NON-adjudicating appropriation↔outlay reconciliation observation emitted by the danjo revenue-ledger discrepancy detector (ADR-2605301600). Per (programCode, fiscalYear) it states the relation between Σ appropriations (A) and Σ outlays (O). CONSTITUTIONAL (mirrors discrepancyObservation G4): `nonAdjudicatingNotice` is required and MUST be true; the `category` enum carries NO crime/violation/guilt value — a legal verdict is UNREPRESENTABLE at the schema layer. O>A is a FACT to surface, NOT a finding of wrongdoing (timing / partial-corpus are declared false-positive modes). `sourceRecordCids` MUST contain ≥2 upstream record CIDs (G5); `methodNoteCid` is required (G6 open method). Legal characterization routes to human counsel via chigiri.

category.description: FACTUAL reconciliation relation ONLY. No crime/violation/guilt value exists (G4).

deltaJpy.description: O − A (a factual difference, not a verdict)

observedPattern.description: Human-readable FACTUAL statement of the relation. MUST NOT contain legal-conclusion language.

sourceRecordCids.description: ≥2 upstream record CIDs grounding the observation (G5)

knownFalsePositiveModes.description: declared FP modes (timing / partial-corpus) — danjo finds, never judges

nonAdjudicatingNotice.description: MUST be true. A factual reconciliation, NOT a legal verdict (G4).
